global: This is a bowl of spicy ramen with a vibrant orange broth, topped with a halved boiled egg, menma, and naruto fish cake. It sits in a patterned ceramic bowl against a stark black background, illuminated to highlight the rich colors and textures.

regions.background: The background is a solid, flat, dark surface with no visible texture or details, appearing as a uniform black void.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with colorful painted rim featuring traditional Japanese figures and geometric patterns.
regions.soup: Spicy ramen broth with noodles, textured surface, golden-orange hue, swirling patterns, and visible ingredients beneath.
regions.cut_egg: A halved boiled egg shows a firm white and a vibrant yellow yolk with a slightly textured surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale yellow, slightly translucent, elongated strips with visible fibrous texture and subtle surface ridges.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: white base with pink spiral, scalloped edge, slightly translucent, smooth surface.
